dashboard.label: Demo Setup
dashboard.description: Install, load, and validate the ServiceNow ES demo app on any Splunk instance.

div.p: Portable synthetic ServiceNow, Mission Control source data, and SOC dashboards.

ol.li: Copy the demo_servicenow_es folder to $SPLUNK_HOME/etc/apps/ on your search head, or install the packaged .tar.gz from the repository dist/ directory.
Restart Splunk or reload the app from Manage Apps.

div.p: Create these indexes before loading demo data:
Use default/indexes.conf.example as a reference on Splunk Enterprise. On Splunk Cloud, create the indexes in the admin console.

div.div: Scripted inputs often do not appear on Splunk Cloud. Open the Load Demo Data dashboard in this app (left nav, second item).

ol.li: Create indexes demo_servicenow and demo_security first.
Open Load Demo Data from the app left navigation (between Demo Setup and Demo Talk Track).
Follow the on-screen steps: test lookup, click each load link, click Run once, validate.

div.p: Alternative (if scripted inputs are visible): Settings > Data inputs > Scripts, enable index_demo_csv.py --all once, then disable.

div.h2: 3b. Why are Scripts missing from Data Inputs?
div.p: Many Splunk Cloud stacks do not expose custom app scripted inputs in the UI. This is expected. The Load Demo Data saved searches above work without Data Inputs.
Confirm lookups loaded: | inputlookup servicenow_incidents_demo | head 5
Open the Demo Searches menu and run:
Primary path: event-based detections with Output > Create findings, or classic ES scheduled alerts with a Finding / Notable action (both populate index=notable and Mission Control).

ol.li: Copy the saved searches demo_es85_detection_soc1_template and demo_es85_detection_soc2_template into Security content > Event-based detections, or create classic ES alerts from the same SPL.
For detections: set Output > Create findings with tokens such as $name$, $description$, and entity type system with $risk_object$ (optional $risk_score$, $severity$).
For classic alerts: enable Trigger Actions > Notable (or Finding action in ES 8.5). Schedule every 5–15 minutes; set earliest to -30d for demo data.
Enable the rules and confirm events in index=notable. You do not need a Mission Control Incidents adaptive response action in ES 8.5.
Run demo_validate_mc_linkage from Demo Searches to confirm cross-index linkage.

In Mission Control, save analyst queue views:
"soc_queue=\"SOC 1 Queue\"" "soc_queue=\"SOC 2 Queue\""

div.div: Use this when ES event-based detections cannot write findings to native Mission Control.

ol.li: Open Mission Control Simulator from this app navigation menu.
Select SOC 1 Queue or SOC 2 Queue from the dropdown.
Use the analyst queue table and drill down to linked ServiceNow INCs.

div.p: | makeresults or | collect index=notable alone usually does not populate native Mission Control in ES 8.5. See docs/MISSION_CONTROL_ALTERNATIVES.md in this app.

ol.li: Open Demo Talk Track from this app navigation for a 25–30 minute presenter script.
Open SOC Case Management for ServiceNow queue, Mission Control linkage, and KPI panels.
Optional: import docs/soc_case_management_dashboard_studio.json into Dashboard Studio for a richer layout (see dashboards/README.md in the repository).

div.h2: 7. Refresh dates before a live demo
div.p: From the repository root on a machine with Python 3:
Reinstall or copy the refreshed app to your Splunk search head, then reload the scripted inputs with --force.
